caption:
Her eyes turn red, then the fight starts.
Seedance 2.5 made every kick land.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 31 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: hyper-detailed photoreal CGI, AAA game-cinematic quality, realistic skin and fabric, shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look. Night: cold blue moonlight from a bright full moon, dark lacquered wood, rain-wet glossy floorboards with strong reflections, drifting mist, deep blue-black shadows; every one of her hits releases a burst of glowing red energy that bathes the scene in red. Camera feel: smooth cinematic orbits and slow push-ins for the calm beats, fast handheld-style tracking for the fight, slow-motion speed ramps on the big impacts. Pacing: calm and teasing for 6 seconds, then fast martial-arts action with two slow-motion peaks, ending calm. No blood, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTERS:
- THE KUNOICHI: a young East Asian woman (about 25), slim and athletic, porcelain skin, delicate face, full lips, a playful confident smile. Long dark brown-black hair tied in a high ponytail with a cream silk bow, loose wavy side locks framing her face. Brown eyes that turn glowing red (shot 3 onward). Outfit: a crimson-red silk scarf wound around her neck with long tails trailing behind her; a short sleeveless kimono-style top in grey-green silk with red and gold flower embroidery, cut with a deep V neckline; a navy-blue obi sash tied with a thin red cord; one ornate black-and-gold armored pauldron on her left shoulder; black fingerless gloves with gold-trimmed armored bracers; black thigh-high stockings with a red garter strap holding small kunai on her right thigh; black-and-gold armored greaves over heeled boots; a katana in a black scabbard at her left hip. Signature in every shot: the red scarf and the cream ponytail bow.
- THE ATTACKERS: about eight middle-aged Japanese men in dark charcoal and navy kimono with wide hakama trousers and white tabi socks with sandals; short black hair or shaved crowns with small topknots, stubble, rough faces, cocky grins.

LOCATION: a long open-sided veranda corridor of a traditional Japanese wooden temple at night: tall dark lacquered pillars in a long row, a dark wooden ceiling with hanging lanterns, a low wooden railing (one section painted red) on the left, dark forest trees outside the railing, a big bright full moon in the upper left of the frame, the polished floorboards wet and mirror-like.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.9) — The tease. Medium shot, slow push-in: the kunoichi stands calmly in the corridor, eyes lowered, a small smile; on the left an attacker leans in and reaches out to touch her hair and ponytail bow mockingly. Other attackers stand behind her along the corridor, watching. Moon top left.
SHOT 2 (00:02.9-00:03.1) — Flash: a quick white flash frame.
SHOT 3 (00:03.1-00:05.8) — Red eyes. Close-up of her face, slow push-in: she lifts her gaze to the lens, her eyes ignite into glowing red light, and her small smile widens into a confident, playful grin. Background soft, blurred attackers.
SHOT 4 (00:05.8-00:07.3) — First dodge. Medium shot: the attacker on the left throws a punch at her face; she leans back, ponytail whipping, slips under his arm and drives her armored forearm into his chest.
SHOT 5 (00:07.3-00:12.8) — Red impact. MUST SHOW: her palm strike lands on his chest and explodes in a burst of glowing red energy, red light flooding both of them, sparks flying. He is blasted backward off his feet down the corridor, splinters and mist flying. Then a slow orbit around her: she stands in a ready martial-arts stance, glowing red eyes, smiling, as the other attackers start walking toward her from the back of the corridor; one rushes in from the right.
SHOT 6 (00:12.8-00:13.6) — Spin kick. Side view, medium-wide: she spins and lands a high kick on a grinning attacker's jaw, his head snaps back.
SHOT 7 (00:13.6-00:15.6) — Sweep. Medium-wide tracking: she grabs and sweeps another attacker, high-kicks a third who crashes to the floor; she drops into a low crouch over a man lying on the floorboards.
SHOT 8 (00:15.6-00:17.7) — Flying knee. Low angle: she leaps into a flying knee strike, both of them airborne in front of the full moon, the attacker engulfed in glowing red energy, her red scarf streaming. Slow motion, then a burst of smoke and mist as he is flung away; she lands.
SHOT 9 (00:17.7-00:19.4) — The charge. Low frontal tracking shot: she sprints straight at the lens down the wet corridor, the camera pulling back fast, a defeated man lying behind her.
SHOT 10 (00:19.4-00:19.6) — Flash: a blurred whip of motion.
SHOT 11 (00:19.6-00:26.9) — The final strikes. Wide side view along the corridor, the red railing on the left: she slides in and lands a front kick on an attacker; slow-motion speed ramp as her kick hits his torso and a burst of red energy erupts, red light on the railing; he is blasted away. She steps forward as another attacker runs in; he grabs at her shoulder, she twists and elbows him; she launches a leaping flying side kick. MUST SHOW: at the moment of impact time nearly freezes: a huge translucent spherical shockwave bubble expands around the attacker, who glows red from inside, splinters and debris hanging mid-air, her body fully extended in the air.
SHOT 12 (00:26.9-00:27.0) — Flash: a quick bright flash frame.
SHOT 13 (00:27.0-00:30.8) — The exit. She lands softly in drifting mist, then medium close-up, slow push-in: she raises her fists in a guard, smiles straight into the lens with a playful look, then turns away; wide from behind: she walks slowly away down the long moonlit corridor, the red scarf tails and her ponytail swaying, katana at her hip, the moon top left.

SOUND: an intense cinematic taiko-and-strings action score with deep drums and a dark synth undertone, no vocals. Shot 1: rain dripping, wooden floor creaks, a mocking chuckle from the man. Shot 3: a low hum as her eyes ignite. Shots 4-11: punches, kicks and grunts, cloth whips, heavy bassy energy blasts with crackling sparks on each red impact, wood splintering, bodies crashing onto the floor, fast footsteps splashing on wet boards; on the slow-motion kick the sound drops to a deep muffled boom and a ringing tone. Shot 13: the score fades to quiet rain and her soft footsteps. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Photoreal CGI, moonlit wooden temple corridor at night. A kunoichi in a red scarf and floral armor is mocked by kimono-clad men; her eyes glow red, she smiles and takes them all down with kicks and strikes that burst in red energy, then walks away.
